newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Stockland to raise A$125 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Stockland to raise A$125 mln of debt.

text.p: Stockland Trust Group said on Thursday it would raise A$125 million through the issue of 6.65 percent unsecured convertible bonds maturing on December 31, 2001.
The property investment firm said the issue was made to institutional investors, with CS First Boston acting as broker and also as underwriter of A$100 million of the bond issue.
Stockland said the bonds were convertible into new units from December 1, 1998, at A$3.50 per unit. The units closed five cents lower at A$3.20 on Thursday.
There would be 35.71 million units created if the issue was fully subscribed and converted. Stockland has 326.73 million units on issue.
The company said the funds would be used for future acquisitions.
